subject.title: Android: add adaptive app navigation sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Material 3 adaptive navigation redesign as the Android shell’s supported primary-navigation model once final-head device proof is available?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes the default Android navigation experience across phones, tablets, desktop-sized windows, and foldables; implementation correctness does not by itself decide whether that product-wide presentation change should become the maintained default.

options.title: Sponsor adaptive navigation
options.body: Accept the Material 3 bar/rail/drawer direction after final-head proof verifies the intended layouts and secondary-drawer interaction.

options.title: Keep the current shell model
options.body: Decline the navigation redesign and retain the existing Android navigation behavior until a narrower user problem warrants a targeted change.

recommendation.title: Sponsor adaptive navigation
recommendation.body: Accept the Material 3 bar/rail/drawer direction after final-head proof verifies the intended layouts and secondary-drawer interaction.
